title: Validate the iHRIS knowledge graph
description: Checks every ihris-* node against src/schemas/, every folio-catalogue(-node)/v1 file and Tool node against folio-assistant's own zod schemas, and that metadataRef, module parent/formClasses and releaseFile references resolve.

install.cli: pip install jsonschema; a folio-assistant checkout with `bun install` (FOLIO_ASSISTANT=<path>)
